children: Kyverna Therapeutics reported positive one-year durability and safety data for miv-cel in stiff person syndrome and longer-term Phase 2 follow-up in generalized myasthenia gravis.
KYSA-8 one-year data (n=26) show sustained median T25FW improvement (~49% at 12 months; p < 0.0001) and 95% maintained clinically meaningful benefit.
92% of SPS patients remained free of chronic immunotherapies at one year; 67% of prior aid‑users no longer require walking assistance.
KYSA-6 Phase 2 follow-up (n=7) shows all patients met co‑primary endpoints at 24 weeks; durable benefits to 1–1.5 years in five patients.
Safety profile consistent and well‑tolerated: no high‑grade CRS, no ICANS, and no IEC‑HS reported in one‑year follow‑up across trials.
Rolling BLA submission for SPS on track for completion in Q4 2026; Phase 3 gMG enrollment expected to complete mid‑2027.
